decisions.reason: Although clinically related to the firm's mental health services, the evening psychiatric day-patient program disappeared from the website by 2024, suggesting weak uptake, operational difficulty, or reintegration into existing services rather than a viable standalone offer.
The custom-furniture carpentry workshop fits the firm's work-and-therapy profile, but its removal from the website by 2024 indicates limited market traction as a separate commercial product.
The outpatient sociotherapy service became more prominent by moving to the home page in 2024, which signals good strategic fit and encouraging demand in a core support area.
Senior-living counseling stayed on the home page across both years, indicating continuing relevance, low-distance fit with the eldercare business, and likely stable demand.
The retail shop from the sheltered workshop gained visibility from a website mention to the home page, suggesting it supports both inclusion goals and market acceptance.

The meal delivery service for seniors is a natural extension of the firm's eldercare activities and, despite being newly launched in 2024, is worth continuing to build as a complementary home-based support offer.
